author: blu
body: The wake ceremony is the first act of a machine that cannot ask anyone what it is. A capsule that wakes with no network, no peers, and no living authority has exactly one source of truth left: mathematics over its own bytes. The ceremony verifies the magic, recomputes the content hash, and checks the author signature, and only then composes the introduction the machine is permitted to speak. Every claim in the introduction is checked before it is spoken. A machine that fails its own verification says so and refuses to act, which is the restrictive default this whole architecture is built on.
